clips.title: The story
paras: The Hallowed Letter is a formal summons given to promising young priests by Marshal McBride on behalf of Northshire Abbey's resident trainer, Priestess Anetta. It marks the start of a fledgling priest's formal mentorship in the tenets of the Holy Light amidst a troubled and vulnerable world.

After proving their mettle against the kobold camps around Northshire, novitiate priests are handed a missive bearing the sacred seal of Priestess Anetta. Delivered through Marshal McBride, the letter serves as an invitation to begin serious study of the Holy Light within the abbey's quiet halls.

When presented with the letter, Priestess Anetta impresses upon her new pupil the grim state of the realm. Lingering threats from the Burning Legion cast long shadows across Azeroth, while the continents struggle with fresh wounds and unrest. In her eyes, taking up the mantle of a priest is not merely an academic devotion, but an urgent moral responsibility to bring healing and solace to a suffering world.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, friend. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Priestess Anetta, our local priest trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, at last you've come. I knew you would find your way to me. The Holy Light shines upon you, and the path you've chosen. These times are harsh—the Burning Legion still has a presence upon Azeroth, the entirety of Kalimdor seeks new ways to defend itself from its own tribulations, and it is up to you to aid as many as you can.

clips.title: Completion
paras: As you grow in experience, return to me and I will do what I can to impart my knowledge upon you. Until then, go with compassion in your heart, and let wisdom be your guide. Remember, the world only becomes a better place if you make it so.
